summary: testSidebarTogglesKeepCenterChatVisible drives real left/right pane toggles and asserts genuine geometry: center title/transcript/composer stay hittable, fully inside the window frame, and non-overlapping with visible (non-empty-frame) shell.leftPane/rightPane regions after each toggle, plus a real keystroke into the composer confirms interactivity; helpers use real XCUIElement frames (not stubs) and panes collapse to zero-width in source, so the checks would fail on a real overlap/hiding regression.
